title: EVALAGENT: Discovering Implicit Evaluation Criteria from the Web
reasoning: The paper introduces EVALAGENT, a framework for generating task-specific evaluation criteria for LLM outputs. While it mentions the goal of uncovering 'human-valued' criteria, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics. Its focus is on general-purpose writing tasks (e.g., academic talks, fiction, technical documentation) and technical metrics like specificity and actionability.
